about: Test bench styles (bullets). Every directional signal is paper-traded once per style, 1 lot, with honest fills (buy at the ask, sell at the bid, every charge). A style is a list of legs: side 'with' = the option that gains if the signal is right (CE for up, PE for down), 'against' = the other side (PE for up, CE for down); offset = strikes from the at-the-money strike (+ = out of the money, - = in the money); q = +1 bought, -1 sold. Family is worked out from the legs: only bought = buying, only sold = selling, both = buying + selling. exit: target_pct / stop_pct are % of the premium paid (or received, for credit trades) as profit / loss; null = the paper account's setting. hold_min null = the paper account's time limit; to_close true = held to the 15:15 close unless the target or stop comes first. A style whose legs have no live price (most stocks stream only the at-the-money strike) is skipped for that signal. Add a style here; no code change. A broken entry is skipped and shown on the System page; the rest keep running.
